info.title: RSVP Template and Media API
info.description: Template/Media Service (lane 16, Django + DRF). Behind Kong at /media (prefix stripped). Errors are RFC 9457 problems. 1.2.0 (F1, additive; the unmerged 1.1.0 of the same change set is superseded): a template theme is either the v1 theme (unchanged) or the invitation design document v2 (DesignDocumentV2, schemaVersion 2), validated against this contract. A v2 without the gifts block is 422 GIFTS_BLOCK_REQUIRED; the mandatory gifts button cannot be redirected, hidden, shrunk below 44 px, moved out of the canvas, covered or left unreadable (GIFTS_BLOCK_LOCKED, GIFTS_BLOCK_HIDDEN, GIFTS_BLOCK_OUT_OF_CANVAS, GIFTS_BLOCK_TOO_SMALL, GIFTS_BLOCK_COVERED, GIFTS_BLOCK_LOW_CONTRAST). Until F4/F5 the admin and the renderer cannot read a v2: POST/PATCH with a v2 theme is 422 DESIGN_V2_NOT_AVAILABLE, the admin list leaves v2 rows out and publishing one is 422 DESIGN_NOT_PUBLISHABLE. The gifts button keeps 44 px of useful height after padding and border and a label of at most 32 px. Poppins and IBM Plex leave the font catalogue. Custom HTML/CSS is 422 CUSTOM_CODE_UNAVAILABLE until the F5 sanitiser exists. A JSON body over 1 MB is 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. Low-contrast colour pairs come back as non-blocking warnings (P19). 1.3.0 (F1, additive): per-celebration design storage. A design has a working draft, immutable published versions that can be restored into the draft (P15) and may be a host's private template (P21). Endpoints under /designs; publishing a celebration design emits template.design.published.v1 (AsyncAPI 1.23.0).

DraftIfMatch.name: If-Match
DraftIfMatch.description: draftVersion being edited, e.g. "3". Missing → 428; stale → 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

missingFields.description: Present on 422 PUBLISH_REQUIREMENTS_MISSING: exactly the fields the event type still requires

warnings.description: Only on create and edit responses of a v2 theme: colour pairs under WCAG AA. They never block saving (P19).

status.description: PROCESSING while the variant worker has not finished; REJECTED if the image could not be decoded after retries.

DesignId.description: Identifier unique within one design document (kebab-case).

ColourRole.description: A palette role; the renderer takes its value from the palette of the guest's colour scheme.

CoverVariant.description: Cover composition. The five values are the v1 layouts; F4 adds new ones.

FontFamilyId.description: A family of the curated catalogue (P11). The catalogue, with the exact weights of each family and the tested pairs, is x-rsvp-font-catalog. Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Poppins and IBM Plex are excluded (Poppins became DM Sans and IBM Plex Sans became Source Sans 3 in templates, by data migration 0002).

x-rsvp-font-catalog.description: Curated families with their exact weights, tested pairs and the origins to preconnect before the stylesheet (PL-M10). The renderer loads only the weights a document uses (F6).

weights.description: Exact weights to load; each must exist for the family in the catalogue (else 422 FONT_WEIGHT_UNAVAILABLE).

DesignPalette.description: The eight colour roles. accentFill is the accent used as a fill (cover band, buttons) and onAccent the ink set on it.

palettes.description: Light and dark palettes of the same template (P8). The renderer follows the guest's prefers-color-scheme.

unit.description: Spacing grid in px; every padding and margin is a multiple of 4.

contentMaxWidth.description: Maximum width of the content column in px

ornament.description: Ornament set id. F3 adds the per-template ornaments.

illustrationSet.description: Illustration set id. F3 adds the invitation library.

DesignBox.description: Padding or margin in px, on the 4 px grid.

scrim.description: Veil over the image so text stays readable

size.description: px; 13 is the floor for any text (plan F5)

entrance.description: Played once on entering the viewport; prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state (P18).

href.description: External https link, opened with rel="noopener noreferrer".

listingId.description: Provider listing; always rendered through /r/{listingId} so the lead is counted.

h.description: Height in rows (minimum height in a flow canvas)

rotation.description: Degrees; default 0. The gifts block is never rotated (422 GIFTS_BLOCK_LOCKED).

visible.description: Visibility in this canvas. The gifts block can never be hidden (422 GIFTS_BLOCK_HIDDEN).

opacity.description: Default 1. The gifts block is always 1 (422 GIFTS_BLOCK_HIDDEN).

link.description: Destination of the element. Not allowed on the element that places the gifts block: its destination is always /c/{slug}/regalos (422 GIFTS_BLOCK_LOCKED).

DesignElement.description: One placed block. Coordinates are grid units of its canvas. A canvas is columns x rowHeight px and ends 4000 px below its top; an element lies inside it. The gifts element is at least 44 x 44 px (reference widths 320 px mobile, 768 px desktop, capped by contentMaxWidth), keeps 44 px of height once its top and bottom padding and twice its border width are taken out (GIFTS_BLOCK_TOO_SMALL), has a label of at most 32 px whose line fits that height (GIFTS_BLOCK_TEXT_TOO_LARGE), is not covered by a visible element that paints over it (higher z, or the same z and later in the list) and reads at 4.5:1 for its text and 3:1 for its contour in both palettes.

mode.description: flow: elements stack by y with automatic height (documents converted from v1). free: absolute placement on the grid (P5).

columns.description: Grid columns: 4 on mobile and 12 on desktop by default

rowHeight.description: Height of one grid row in px

DesignCanvases.description: Two free canvases (P9). Without desktop, the desktop view is the mobile canvas scaled.

required.description: Mandatory block (P22): it can be moved, resized and restyled, never removed, hidden, covered or redirected.

label.description: Custom label; without it the label follows gifts.status

ref.description: https link to YouTube or YouTube Music.
https link to a Spotify track, album, playlist, episode, show or artist.
Id of a media asset of the platform. Whether it exists and belongs to the same celebration or template is checked by the design store (BE #135).

config.description: The reference is checked against an allowlist per source when saved: never a free string that a renderer could turn into a URL.

html.description: Allowlisted HTML (no script, iframe, form, object, embed, style or on* attributes). Checked when saved and sanitised again when rendered (P2).

css.description: CSS scoped to the invitation when rendered: no @import, url(), position: fixed, escapes or comments (P2).

heading.description: CSS font stack of the v1 template: family names, quotes, commas and hyphens only.

body.description: CSS font stack of the v1 template: family names, quotes, commas and hyphens only.

DesignOrigin.description: Provenance of a document converted from v1: the exact v1 font stacks, layout and section order, so the conversion is reversible. Renderers ignore it.

pages.description: One cover page first, then the section pages in order.

blocks.description: Must contain the gifts block (P22); a document without it is 422 GIFTS_BLOCK_REQUIRED.

DesignDocumentV2.description: Invitation design document v2 (plan F1). Single source of truth of its shape; the BE validator and the FE types derive from it.

DesignWarning.description: A palette pair under WCAG AA. The design is still saved (P19); suggestion is the nearest tone of the foreground that passes.

TemplateTheme.description: v1 theme, or design document v2 when schemaVersion is 2. Any other shape is 422 INVALID_THEME.

DesignProblem.description: 422 of a v2 design (400 and 413 are plain Problems). code is INVALID_THEME (not an object, neither v1 nor v2, or a schemaVersion that is not the integer 2), DESIGN_SCHEMA_INVALID (issues lists the paths), GIFTS_BLOCK_REQUIRED (no gifts block, said before the schema errors), GIFTS_BLOCK_LOCKED (link or rotation on the gifts element), GIFTS_BLOCK_HIDDEN (not visible or translucent), GIFTS_BLOCK_OUT_OF_CANVAS, GIFTS_BLOCK_TOO_SMALL (under 44 px, or under 44 px of height left once vertical padding and border are taken out), GIFTS_BLOCK_TEXT_TOO_LARGE (label over 32 px or taller than the useful height), GIFTS_BLOCK_COVERED (another element paints over it), GIFTS_BLOCK_LOW_CONTRAST (text under 4.5:1 or contour under 3:1 in either palette), DESIGN_REFERENCE_INVALID, FONT_WEIGHT_UNAVAILABLE, CUSTOM_CODE_UNAVAILABLE (custom html/css until the F5 sanitiser), DESIGN_NOT_PUBLISHABLE (publishing a v2: it stays a draft until the renderer supports it) or DESIGN_V2_NOT_AVAILABLE (POST/PATCH of any v2 theme until F4/F5: the admin and the renderer cannot read it yet; checked before the document is validated). Design endpoints add VERSION_CONFLICT (409, currentVersion), DESIGN_EXISTS (409), PRIVATE_TEMPLATE_LIMIT (409), DESIGN_PUBLISHED (409, a published celebration design cannot be deleted), DESIGN_TOO_LARGE, DESIGN_MEDIA_INVALID (a mediaId that is not a usable photo of the celebration; mediaIds lists them), DESIGN_MEDIA_NOT_ALLOWED (a private template cannot reference photos; mediaIds lists them), CELEBRATION_REQUIRED, CELEBRATION_NOT_ALLOWED and KIND_REQUIRED (422).

celebrationId.description: Required for CELEBRATION; absent for PRIVATE_TEMPLATE

templateId.description: Start from a published template (a v1 template is converted to v2)

fromDesignId.description: Start from another design the caller can read (P21: save a celebration design as a private template)

DesignInput.description: Send exactly one of templateId, fromDesignId or document.

draftVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token of the draft; send it in If-Match

publishedVersion.description: Latest published version, null until the first publish

warnings.description: Contrast warnings of the draft; present on create, save and restore. They never block (P19)

DesignPublished.description: 201 when a new version was created; 200 when the draft was already the latest published version (idempotent)
